controls.regle: Every code change, whether application code or infrastructure as code, is subject before merge to automated convention checks (lint, format, policy validation) and a review by at least one peer, in a blocking manner.
controls.verification: Verify the configuration of the automated checks (linter, formatter, policy validation) triggered on every proposed change, as well as the requirement for a review approval before merge.
controls.preuve_attendue: CI configuration of the linter/formatter/policy + branch protection configuration requiring an approved review.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = automated checks and review mandatory and blocking ; partial = only one of the two ; non-compliant = merge possible without check or review
actions_audit: Verify the linter/formatter/policy validation configuration triggered on every proposed change; attach the CI configuration.
Confirm from the pull request history the absence of merges without a review approval; document the result.
If a gap is found: activate the automated checks and the branch protection requiring review.

controls.regle: The results of security scans (SAST, secrets, dependencies) run in continuous integration are tracked by version and integrated as a code quality criterion, on the same footing as test coverage and technical debt.
controls.verification: Verify that scan results are retained by version (history) and reviewed or aggregated in the same dashboard or process as the other code quality indicators.
controls.preuve_attendue: History of scan results by version + quality dashboard including the security indicator.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = results tracked by version and integrated into the quality dashboard ; partial = results tracked without integration into quality tracking ; non-compliant = results not retained
actions_audit: Verify the historical retention of scan results by version; attach the excerpt.
Confirm the integration of the security indicator into the code quality dashboard or process; document the result.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing retention and integration.

controls.regle: Unit test coverage is measured at every integration, with a minimum threshold defined and verified automatically.
controls.verification: Run or review the latest coverage report; verify the presence of a configured minimum threshold and the pipeline's behavior when coverage falls below the threshold.
controls.preuve_attendue: Coverage report by module + minimum threshold configuration in CI + evidence of a pipeline failure below the threshold.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = coverage measured, threshold defined and blocking ; partial = coverage measured without a blocking threshold ; non-compliant = coverage not measured
actions_audit: Extract the latest test coverage report by module; attach the report.
Verify the minimum threshold configuration in CI and trigger a regression test to confirm the blocking behavior; document the result.
If a gap is found: define the threshold and activate the missing blocking behavior.

controls.regle: Critical functional journeys are covered by automated integration (or end-to-end) tests, run on every change.
controls.verification: Identify the critical journeys (declared in D00) and verify the existence of integration/e2e tests covering them, run automatically on every change.
controls.preuve_attendue: List of critical journeys with associated test + integration test execution report.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all critical journeys covered and run automatically ; partial = partial coverage of critical journeys ; non-compliant = no integration test observed
actions_audit: Identify the critical functional journeys and look for the corresponding integration/e2e tests; attach the mapping.
Verify the automatic execution of these tests on every change; document the result.
If a gap is found: develop the missing integration tests for the uncovered journeys.

controls.regle: Cyclomatic complexity and technical debt (TODO/FIXME, excessively long functions) are measured periodically and tracked over time, with a documented alert threshold.
controls.verification: Run or review the complexity analysis tool (radon, ESLint complexity, or equivalent); verify the tracking over time and the existence of a documented alert threshold.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated complexity report + trend history + documented alert threshold.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = periodic measurement tracked over time with an alert threshold ; partial = one-off measurement without trend tracking ; non-compliant = complexity/debt not measured
actions_audit: Run or review the complexity and technical debt analysis tool; attach the dated report.
Verify the trend tracking over time and the existence of a documented alert threshold; document the finding.
If a gap is found: tool the missing periodic measurement and define the alert threshold.

controls.regle: The entire test suite (unit and integration) is run automatically on every proposed change, with a pipeline that blocks on any failure.
controls.verification: Verify the CI pipeline configuration triggering the test suite on every change and the effective blocking of the merge or deployment in case of failure.
controls.preuve_attendue: CI pipeline configuration + evidence of a recent block due to test failure.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = full suite run and 100% blocking ; partial = run without systematic blocking ; non-compliant = tests not run in CI
actions_audit: Verify the pipeline configuration triggering the full test suite on every change; attach the configuration.
Trigger a deliberate test failure in a test environment and confirm the pipeline blocks; document the result.
If a gap is found: fix the configuration to make the pipeline block on failure.
